Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Indian players make their way out to the middle. Jason Roy and Jos Buttler are the openers for England. Bhuvneshwar Kumar has a brand new ball in his hand. One slip in place. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, England have a par score to chase here. They have a powerful batting line-up and would be fancing their chances to chase this one. Indian bowlers were brilliant in the first game, can they defend this total? We shall find out.

England were put under pressure with the ball in the Powerplay but the debutant Richard Glesson brought them back in the game with three quick wickets as India were reduced to 61-3 from 49-0. Jordan was also brilliant for the second game in the row and did not allow India to take the game away from England at any point in time. Richard Gleeson and Jordan were the only wicket-takers for England taking three and four wickets respectively. The English bowlers have done quite well here and it is upto the batters now to chase this total down.

There has been a lot of talk about how India will approach T20 cricket and they have given us some solid answers in this series so far. They took the aggressive option again and started off with a bang with Pant and Rohit going great guns. Rohit departed after a breezy knock and Kohli and Pant followed him soon. However, the Indian batters did not shy away from playing their shots and despite losing wickets at regular intervals, India continued to score briskly. Jadeja made sure that he bats till the end and finished with 46 from 29 balls and that has taken India to a decent total here.

A competitive total on the board from India courtesy of a fine cameo by Jadeja in the end. However, England will go into the break as a happier side. They were much better with the ball in this game compared to the last one and have a real chance now to level this series here at Edgbaston.

Pushing for two and the misfield will allow them to come back for the second with ease. Full and straight, this is pushed right back past the bowler but the fielder from mid off charges towards it and fails to collect it cleanly. Two taken. India finish with 170/8!
Easy two there! Full and on leg stump, Jadeja gets an inside edge towards the vacant square leg region and races back for the second.
Gets away with one there Sam Curran. Yet another juicy full toss, this time Jadeja miscues it towards deep mid-wicket and it will be a dot ball.
FOUR! Poor from Sam Curran and Ravindra Jadeja isn't going to miss out on that one. Another full toss on the pads, this is picked up and dispatched behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Length this time, angling into leg stump. Jadeja swings it away towards deep mid-wicket and doesn't take the single.
WIDE! Tries to bowl full and attack the pads but spills it down leg, wide called.
Brilliantly fielded! A full toss on the pads, this is flicked away to the right of short fine leg but the fielder over there makes a good half stop. The batters do pick up a couple of runs.
Jasprit Bumrah is the next man in. Sam Curran to bowl the last over!

OUT! TAKEN! There to be hit but Bhuvneshwar Kumar finds the fielder! Full and wide, almost a half-volley. Kumar stays deep in his crease and looks to thrash it through extra cover and he gets the connection too, just not the elevation. The ball goes straight towards David Willey at extra cover and he takes a sharp catch. Chris Jordan finishes off his spell with a four-fer!
Commentary.Howout: c David Willey b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: Switches to over the wicket and serves a very full ball on off stump, Jadeja pushes it out on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Goes full again but not full enough, Jadeja drills this one past the man at mid off and picks up a much-needed boundary.
Excellent from Jordan! Comes from around the wicket and nails the yorker on the pads. Ravindra Jadeja gets cramped for room and fails to get it away as the ball hits him on the pads.
back of a length, on off, Bhuvneshwar Kumar plays it through covers for one more.
Slower delivery, on a good length and angling into middle and leg. Jadeja advances and hits it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

A single to finish off an exceptional spell on debut. Richard Gleeson ends with figures of, 4-1-15-3! This is shorter and on leg stump, Ravindra Jadeja tucks it away past square leg for just a single.
Good running, easy two in the end! Full again, on middle and leg, this is worked well in front of square on the leg side for a brace. The 150 is up for India.

Sloppy from England yet again! Very full and wide, a low full toss. Ravindra Jadeja slices it towards deep point for a single and the throw from the deep is a difficult one for the keeper. Jos Buttler misses it and the batters are able to sneak in an extra run.
Good length, on middle and leg, Kumar tucks it away towards square leg for one.
A bit of yes and no but they survive. Around the top of off, Bhuvneshwar Kumar nudges it towards point and looks for the quick single but is sent back by Jadeja and rightly so.
This is dug in a bit short and on leg stump, Jadeja pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar walks out to the middle and it will be Richard Gleeson to bowl his final over.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chris Jordan has the last laugh and picks up his third wicket of the game. Goes short again, over middle but this time with a lot more pace behind it. Harshal Patel backs away and tries to ramp it over third man for another maximum but ends up just timing it into the hands of the fielder over there. Richard Gleeson takes a simple catch and India lose their seventh wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Richard Gleeson b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Off the meat of the bat! Short of a length, slower and angling into the body, Patel with a short-arm jab over wide long on for a maximum. Brilliant hit.
Goes full and on off, Harshal Patel backs away to go downtown but only manages to hit it firmly towards mid on.
Excellent running! Length, around off, Patel hangs deep and just opens the face of the bat to guide it towards third man for a couple of runs.
And again but this time the fielder at point makes a good half stop. Back of a length, outside off, Jadeja cuts it to the right of point and picks up a single.
FOUR! The boundaries are flowing now for India. A tad shorter and with ample width on offer, Jadeja waits for it and just taps it behind point for a boundary.
FOUR! Flighted delivery, just a bit too full and wide, Harshal Patel creams this one through covers and picks up a boundary.
Pushed outside off, this is just caressed past covers for a single.
Quicker and a tad shorter on off, Jadeja defends it back on the deck.
FOUR! Nicely played! Floated up, full and around off, Ravindra Jadeja just goes inside-out over extra cover and bisects the fielders at the cover fence and long off for a boundary.
A low full toss, on leg stump. This is pushed through wide mid on for a single.

OUT! RUN OUT! A huge mix-up in the middle and England have the breakthrough they needed. Quicker and flatter, this is cut away behind point by Ravindra Jadeja. The batters push for two but Harry Brook on the backward point fence is quick to get to the ball. Dinesh Karthik is halfway down the track when he is sent back and has to put in the dive. The throw is a bullet and Jos Buttler very calmly whips off the bails. The third umpire is called in and the replays show that Karthik is short of his crease.
Harshal Patel is the next man in.

FIVE WIDES! Smartly bowled but it has backfired for Liam Livingstone. Sees Jadeja stepping out and pushes it wider, a bit too wide though and Jos Buttler misses it too. The ball runs away into the third man fence.
Curran bangs it short again on middle. Ravindra Jadeja pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A short delivery on middle. Dinesh Karthik pulls it past square leg for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Dinesh Karthik looks to drive it away but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
WIDE! Drifts down the leg side. This is a length delivery and Karthik who tries to work it away, misses.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is full on the pads. Dinesh Karthik flicks it uppishly but in the gap towards the backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Jadeja dabs it behind square on the off side for a single.
Jadeja backs away here and Curran follows him with a yorker. Jadeja manges to dig it out back to the bowler.
Sam Curran (1-0-7-0) comes in to replace David Willey.
Goes flatter and quicker around off. Jadeja cuts it to sweeper cover for a single. Just 6 from this over!
Tossed up on middle. Dinesh Karthik works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller into middle and leg. Dinesh Karthik looks to sweep it but mistimes it completely.
Shorter and outside off. Dinesh Karthik cuts it to deep point. The fielder in the deep moves to his left and dives to stop it near the fence. Two runs taken.
Goes fuller on middle. Jadeja works it wide of long on for a single.
A shorter delivery, outside off. Dinesh Karthik drags it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Oh no, it's gone through! This is on a shorter length and around leg stump. Ravindra Jadeja half-pulls it off his hips towards the backward square leg fence. The fielder on the square leg fence runs around and seems to have stopped it but the ball goes through and touches the ropes.
On the fuller side on middle. Dinesh Karthik works it wide of mid on for a single.
Back of a length, angling into off. Dinesh Karthik looks to slap it away but mistimes it.
Goes fuller on off. Dinesh Karthik skips down the track and hits it without much timing to mid off. The fielder there has a shy at the batter's end but it is too wide and the batters get two.
This is full on off. Ravindra Jadeja drives it to mid on for a single.
Lands on a length, angling into pads. Ravindra Jadeja works it towards fine leg for a couple.
David Willey (2-0-25-0) is back on.
Pulls his length back and it is around off. Dinesh Karthik rides the bounce and defends it towards the off side. Another good over from Richard Gleeson, just 2 from it.
A length delivery on off. Dinesh Karthik defends it solidly.
Beaten again! Short of good length and around off. Dinesh Karthik looks to defend it off the back foot but gets beaten off the outside edge again.
Lands on a length, on off. Dinesh Karthik blocks it out.
WIDE! On the shorter side and down the leg side. Dinesh Karthik looks to clip it but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Dinesh Karthik looks to defend it off the back foot but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Lands on a length, around off. Jadeja pushes it wide of mid off for a single.
With two net batters at the crease, strike bowler Richard Gleeson (2-1-6-3) is brought back on.
On the shorter side, outside off. Dinesh Karthik leaves it alone. End of a brilliant over by Jordan!
No hat-trick! This is full on middle. Dinesh Karthik drives it to mid on.
Dinesh Karthik comes out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two now for Jordan! Just like Richard Gleeson earlier, Jordan will be on a hat-trick now! Back of a length, around off. Pandya looks to punch it away but the ball gets a little big on him and goes off the shoulder of his blade. It goes towards backward point and Dawid Malan takes his second catch of the game. India are in a spot of bother here!
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: Ravindra Jadeja is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! India lose another as Suryakumar Yadav looks to go big towards the leg side. Jordan has been brilliant with his hard lengths in this series and again he bowls this slightly shorter in length, on off. Suryakumar Yadav looks to pull it but miscues it completely. The ball goes off the top edge towards mid-wicket and Sam Curran running forward takes a fine catch. He seems to hurt himself in the process but it is not much serious and more importantly this is a big wicket for England.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on off. Pandya punches it to extra-cover for a single.
A length delivery on off. Pandya looks to work it towards the leg side. However, he gets a leading edge over mid off and the batters run two.

DRINKS! There has been a lot of talk about how India will approach T20 cricket and we surely have got our answers here. India got off to a flying start but the momentum was derailed a bit by Richard Gleeson, the man on debut who got three wickets in quick succession. However, Pandya and Suryakumar Yadav are looking good and if they can bat together for some more runs we might see another big total from India.

Drilled but just for a single this time. On middle, Pandya steps out and muscles it straight back past the bowler who does get a hand on it. The ball goes towards long off and the batters cross over for a run. 13 off the over and at the halfway stage, India are 86/3!
Around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Flatter and quicker, outside off, this is just slapped away through cover-point for a boundary.

Wristy from Suryakumar Yadav and that's a good bit of fielding from Chris Jordan in the deep. On the pads, SKY flicks it over wide mid on and Jordan runs around quickly from long on to keep it out. Two taken.
On middle and leg, this is pushed through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Tossed-up delivery, on middle. Hardik Pandya steps out and absolutely drills it back past the bowler for a boundary.
On a good length, around off. The ball bounces a bit extra but Pandya does well to keep it down towards covers and picks up a single as well. Tidy first over from Jordan, just four singles off it.
Length again, around off, Yadav stays inside the crease and just guides it down to third man for a single.
A touch fuller and outside off, Pandya pushes it towards mid on and sets off for a quick single. Good running.
BEAUTY! A cross-seamer from Chris Jordan, pushed wider. Pandya goes across the off stump, trying to work it leg side but the ball zips past the outside edge. A slip is now being put in place too.
A huge swing and a miss from Hardik Pandya! Short of a good length and outside off, Pandya looks to smash it over long on but is beaten for pace.
Starts off with a length ball, around the top of off. Yadav punches it through covers and turns the strike over.
Will Richard Gleeson continue? No, Jos Buttler has decided to bring Chris Jordan into the attack now.
Around off, this is driven down to long off for a run.
Drifted onto the pads, SKY gets down low to paddle sweep but can't beat the man at short fine leg.
WIDE! Trying to turn it away from the pads but spills it down leg, wide called.
Nicely flighted, on middle and leg, Pandya leans forward and pushes it through mid on for one more.
Flighted, full and on middle. This is stroked down to long off for just a single.
FOUR! Tossed up, around middle and turning away. Suryakumar Yadav dances down the track, giving himself a bit of room and goes inside-out over covers to pick up a boundary.
Nicely bowled! Floated up on a length and drifting onto the pads. The ball turns away as Suryakumar Yadav awkwardly defends it out.
A double-wicket maiden in a T20I game, absolute gold from Richard Gleeson! Back of a length, around off, Pandya dabs it down towards backward point.
On a hard length again, angling into the body and with a bit of extra zip behind it as well. Pandya does well to fend away the ball.
This is good, confident bowling from Gleeson. Around the top of off and nipping back in a touch. Pandya looks to thrash it through covers but mistimes it badly.
No hat-trick! Richard Gleeson goes full and straight, looking for the yorker. Hardik Pandya with a solid defensive punch towards mid on.
Hardik Pandya walks out to the middle now. He will face the hat-trick ball!

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Two in two for Richard Gleeson and he is on a roll! Length again, on leg stump. Rishabh Pant continues with the aggressive approach and walks towards the ball, trying to swing across the line. The ball goes off the inside edge and Jos Buttler takes an easy catch behind the sticks. Gleeson is on a hat-trick and England making a strong comeback into the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Richard Gleeson

Commentary.Commentary: Suryakumar Yadav is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! An absolute stunner from Dawid Malan! This is bowled on a hard length, around off stump. Virat Kohli with a very unlike Kohli shot tries to smash it back over the bowler's head from inside the crease. The ball flies off the top edge and goes over backward point. Malan runs back quite a fair bit and takes it over his shoulders. Brilliant from Malan and Richard Gleeson has sent back Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli, what a debut!
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b Richard Gleeson

Commentary.Commentary: Kohli is underway! On the pads, this is flicked in front of square on the leg side for a single. At the end of the Powerplay, India are flying at 59/1!
On off, this is pushed towards mid off for a quick single.
Uppish but safe! Floated up around off, Pant looks to slog sweep but mistimes it badly on the bounce to the fielder at mid on.
Flatter delivery, on off stump, Pant can't get it away on the off side.
FOUR! Nonchalantly done! On a shorter length and around leg stump, Pant with a sort of a half-pull, using his wrists and gets it past square leg for a boundary.

SIX! India doing to England what they have been doing to almost everyone else in the last few years. Tossed up, around off. Rishabh Pant steps out and launches it over the vacant long off fence for a biggie.
Back of a length, angling into middle and ;eg. Kohli looks to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards covers. End of a successful first over from Richard Gleeson!
Virat Kohli is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Ohh... Rohit Sharma departs while trying to be aggressive again! Rohit Sharma dances down the track and Richard Gleeson who spots it, bangs it short and angles it onto Rohit's body. He looks to pull this but is hurried by this short delivery and gets a top edge. The ball goes behind the keeper but Buttler runs behind and takes a brilliant diving catch. End of another fine knock from the Indian skipper, it is not a big one but he has given India a good start here. First wicket in T20Is for Richard Gleeson!
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Richard Gleeson

Commentary.Commentary: A length delivery angling into middle and leg. Sharma dances down the track and heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket region. It is not timed perfectly but still enough to add two runs to the score.
Lands on a length, around off. Sharma looks to punch it away but misses.
FOUR! Slammed! Again the fullish length, around off. Sharma just stays deep in his crease and launches it wide of mid on for a boundary.
The debutant starts with a fullish length on off. Sharma drives it to mid off.
Slower in the air and much fuller on middle. Sharma works it behind square on the leg side for a single. 11 runs coming from this over and India is off to a flying start!
FOUR! Another boundary! A half-tracker on middle. Sharma rocks back and pulls it towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Angling into leg. Sharma skips down the track and looks to clip it but the ball hits his pads.
FOUR! Boundaries are coming regularly here! This is around off. Sharma creates the room by backing away and lofts it over the cover fielder in the ring for a boundary.
Pushed quicker on off. Pant drives it to mid off and takes a quick single.
A full toss on middle. Sharma drives it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Brilliant! Pant is playing with the field here! On a length, on leg. Pant just picks it off his pads and gets it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack now.
WIDE! Goes fuller but ends up drifting down the leg side. Pant looks to paddle it in his own unusual way but does not connect.
Back of a length, outside off. Pant looks to cut it this time but misses.
WIDE! Seems like a harsh call of wide this! This is wider outside off. A length delivery and Pant looks to reverse-scoop it, he misses though and it called wide by the umpire.
Drilled straight to mid off. This is full and outside off. Pant hits it hard but finds the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Nicely played! Back of a length, around off. Pant waits for it and just guides it wide of short third man for a boundary.
Fullish and outside off. Sharma drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! The Hitman with his second maximum! Willey goes full in search of some swing, it is on off. Sharma just tonks it over long off for a maximum.
Short delivery this time and it is outside off. Pant lets it go. Good start so far for India!
FOUR! First boundary for Rishabh Pant! This is pitched up on off. Pant gets under it and slams it over mid off for a boundary.
A low full toss on off. Sharma drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Lands on a length, on off. Sharma blocks it off the front foot this time.
Great delivery! A slower length delivery, around off. Sharma looks to defend but gets an edge. However, the ball falls short of the keeper.
Curran with a fullish length again, on off. It swings away a bit and takes the outside edge of Pant's blade who looks to drive. The ball goes towards backward point and a single is taken.
WIDE! Curran starts with a full delivery but it is down the leg side. Pant looks to clip it but misses.
Sam Curran to bowl from the opposite end.
SIX! Rohit Sharma ends the over with a maximum! This is on a length, on the pads. Sharma just picks it off this legs and sends it into the crowd over the backward square leg fence.
Pulls his length back a bit and it is outside off. Sharma goes chasing for it but misses.

Did that carry? Yes, Roy drops a sitter! This is full and around off. Sharma looks to drive it but gets a thick outside edge towards point. It goes low towards Roy at point but still at a comfortable height but Roy drops it.
Pant is off the mark straight away! Goes fuller on off. Pant defends it towards the leg side and takes a quick single.

Willey finds an edge this time but it is wide of the first slip and Rohit Sharma and India are underway! This is full on off. Sharma looks to heave it towards the leg side but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
David Willey starts with a fullish delivery on off. Rohit Sharma pushes it off the front foot to mid off.

We are ready for play! The weather is lovely and the umpires are out in the middle. The English players spread out on the field as Rohit Sharma and Rishabh Pant walk out to open thye innings for India. David Willey has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

Rohit Sharma, the captain of India, says they would have batted first and tells that it is a good pitch. Mentions that he has heard that a game was played here three days back in T20 Blast and they need to adapt quickly. Informs that they have four changes in the playing XI. He tells that it is important to start well and what they did in the Southampton was quite good and they want to continue that. Says that they want to play with the aggressive intent going forward and they understand that there will be failures along the way.

Jos Buttler, the captain of England, says they will bowl first because there are short boundaries and are confident of chasing. Informs that Richard Gleeson and David Willey come in for Topley and Tymal Mills. Adds that Richard Gleeson is good at the death and is excited to see him in action. Mentions that the ground id fantastic and India are well supported here too so should be a great game.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (C) (WK), Dawid Malan, Liam Livingstone, Harry Brook, Moeen Ali, Sam Curran, David Willey, Chris Jordan, Richard Gleeson, Matt Parkinson.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Virat Kohli (In place of Deepak Hooda), Suryakumar Yadav, Rishabh Pant (WK) (In place of Ishan Kishan), Hardik Pandya, Dinesh Karthik, Ravindra Jadeja (In place of Axar Patel), Harshal Patel, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Jasprit Bumrah (In place of Arshdeep Singh), Yuzvendra Chahal.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Jos Buttler. England have elected to BOWL first.

The live pictures show that Richard Gleeson, the 34-year old is getting his cap in the England team's huddle. So we will surely have one change in the England line-up and let's see how the pacer goes about his business on his debut.
